newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk court sentences 10 amid torture claims.
newsitem.headline: Turk court sentences 10 amid torture claims.

text.p: A Turkish court on Thursday sentenced ten students to jail terms ranging from two to 12 years for membership in an illegal leftist group in a case that attracted wide attention because of the students' claims they were tortured by police.

Anatolian news agency said the defendants, mainly teenagers, were also found guilty of throwing a petrol bomb at a barber shop and displaying banners with leftist slogans. Five defendants were found innocent.
Last year a court charged 10 policemen with torturing the students in efforts to extract confessions. That case is continuing.
Turkey has often been the target of criticism from human rights groups for alleged abuses, including the torture of detainees.
